what: False alarm in the expected-signals check live_review_due_stale: its rows-ahead-of-main probe counts a review_id that is dispositioned KILLED in comms/live_review/killed_rows.json (LR-20261031T1529Z-pkg-821a1280782b48a1, malformed packet_sha, killed 2026-10-31 via #21933) and so reports 'the rows mirror is stuck' when the mirror is working (it reports the row as killed). Fix: exclude killed review_ids the same way the 7 schema-refused rows are excluded. Same check also counts 4 due events unreviewed > 120m whose oldest is uso_trend_1h/alpaca_paper on a CLOSED weekend market (1238m); separate question whether closed-market events should count, note only.
